# Debug the inline markup issue
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html, run_postprocessors, striptags, unescape
import html as html_mod

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc'])
text = '#Some *Header* with [markup](http://example.com).'
result = md.convert(text)
print(f"Result: {result}")

# Get the h1 element
for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print(f"\nh1.text: {repr(el.text)}")
        for child in el:
            print(f"  Child tag: {child.tag}, text: {repr(child.text)}, tail: {repr(child.tail)}")
        
        inner = render_inner_html(md, el)
        print(f"\nrender_inner_html: {repr(inner)}")
        
        processed = run_postprocessors(md, inner)
        print(f"run_postprocessors: {repr(processed)}")
        
        stripped = striptags(processed)
        print(f"striptags: {repr(stripped)}")
        
        name = unescape(stripped)
        print(f"unescape: {repr(name)}")
        
        slug_text = html_mod.unescape(name)
        print(f"html.unescape: {repr(slug_text)}")
        break
